chunks: Among the proofs of His creation is the creation of the skies, fastened without pillars,
standing without support. He called them and they responded obediently and humbly, without being lazy or loathsome.

If they had not acknowledged His Godhead and obeyed Him, He would not have made them the place for His throne, the abode of His angels, and the destination for the rising up of 'the pure utterances and the righteous deeds' of the creatures.
ai.seo_question: How does the creation of the heavens demonstrate God's power and lordship according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) uses the cosmological order of the heavens as a primary evidence (shahid) for divine lordship, emphasizing their instantaneous obedience (mud'inat) without physical supports. This passage underscores the metaphysical reality that the celestial spheres serve as the designated abode for the Throne and the conduit for the ascent of righteous deeds, linking cosmic submission to human spiritual efficacy.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Among the proofs of His creation is the creation of the skies which are fastened without pillars and stand without support.
He called them and they responded obediently and humbly without being lazy or loathsome.

If they had not acknowledged His Godhead and obeyed Him He would not have made them the place for His throne, the abode of His angels and the destination for the rising up of ‘the pure utterances and the righteous deeds’ (ref. 35:10) of the creatures.
